 ◆ sshTermy  vdev Idea: Dominik Bornhäußer                                                               ● AI
 ⌨ Customize shortcuts   ⏎ or double-click rebinds · synced to other computers

 EVERYWHERE
▶Command palette               Ctrl+Space / Ctrl+@
 Help                          F1
 About & update                F12
 Quit                          Ctrl+Q
 Manager ↔ terminal            F10
 Explain key bar on/off        Shift+F9 / F21
 TERMINAL
 Goal mode (agent)             F2
 Ask AI                        F3
 Tunnel                        F4
 Files (SFTP)                  F5
 Search history                Ctrl+F
 Split view (2 / 4)            Ctrl+T
 Host overview                 F6
 previous tab                  F7
 next tab                      F8
 Insert follow-up command 1    Alt+1
 Insert follow-up command 2    Alt+2
 Insert follow-up command 3    Alt+3
 Insert follow-up command 4    Alt+4
 Quick commands (list)         F9
 Quick command 1               Shift+F1 / F13
 Quick command 2               Shift+F2 / F14
 Quick command 3               Shift+F3 / F15
 Quick command 4               Shift+F4 / F16

 Alt+⏎ is blocked: Windows Terminal uses it for full screen.
 Font size: Ctrl + plus/minus in the terminal window (macOS: ⌘ + / −)

 ⏎ rebind  Del Default  r reset all  Esc back
